QUOTE: "**Compile time:** define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... **Run time:** leave the macros undefined... `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`... If both macros are defined, `platform.c:20-22` compiles out the whole runtime mechanism, so `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is not declared or available."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair, and it says that defining the macros removes the runtime mechanism, so the two are mutually exclusive.
